title: The Eighteen
note: Arc II denouement. Mnehmos sleeps until six (first time in 15 years). Attends Renata's ward-round; she levels to L3 inside it. Hears Hana's ring removal through the thread; sits with grief for his own dead wife. Sends Ardin a three-sentence dispatch; receives a one-sentence reply. Waits at the chapel doorway through three morning releases. Takes the news of Ardin's death standing. Three words: 'He did the work.' Quiet for an hour. Walks the cloister at noon. The teaching is whole in two schools.
